title: Warehouse Tariff Note: Long Stays and Single-Week Storage — Factory Production Orders
content:
**Tariff note.** For Factory Production Orders, the storage schedule prices the started weeks of billable storage:

1. **more than 4** billable weeks are charged at the weekly storage rate per unit for the first 4 weeks and at **1.5 times** that rate for every later week;
2. a **single** billable week is charged for at least one full bay: the weekly storage rate times the larger of **4 units** and the units on the order;
3. any other number of weeks is charged at the weekly storage rate per unit for every week.

In the first and third cases the rate applies to every unit on the order. The storage fee is never more than the class cap per order and is rounded to the cent.

## Weeks on both sides (hypothetical order of 10 units, weekly rate 9.00 per unit)

| Billable weeks | Charge |
|---|---|
| 1 | the larger of 4 units and 10 units is 10: 10 units at 9.00, 90.00 |
| 2 | 2 weeks at 9.00 for each of 10 units, 180.00 |
| 4 | 4 weeks at 9.00 for each of 10 units, 360.00 |
| 5 | 4 weeks at 9.00 for each of 10 units, 360.00, and 1 week at 13.50 for each of 10 units, 135.00: 495.00 |

## The one-bay minimum for a single week (hypothetical, weekly rate 9.00 per unit)

| Units on the order | Units charged for the single week | Charge |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | 4 | 36.00 |
| 4 | 4 | 36.00 |
| 5 | 5 | 45.00 |

## Hypothetical case

A 10-unit Impact-Rated Build order with 6 billable weeks at 9.00: 360.00 for the first 4 weeks and 270.00 for the next 2 at 13.50, 630.00, held to the 450.00 class cap.
